content:
**Silt Bean Soup** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A soup that is produced by boiling Silt Beans, providing minor benefits to one's constitution.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (1) Silt Bean (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Silt Bean | | Silt Bean Soup (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station, after having picked a Silt Bean for the first time.
- May be bought from Mr. Waiter at the dining room inside the Whitespring Resort.
- Can be found in the Communist Collectron Station, when it is set to run in "Proletariat" mode.
